description: This source file contains unit tests for the OpenClaw configuration file handling on macOS, including parsing, environment variable overrides, URL manipulation, and audit logging.

classes.name: OpenClawConfigFileTests
classes.description: A suite of tests validating the behavior of OpenClaw configuration file handling, including environment overrides, URL schemes, JSON loading and saving, and audit log checks.

methods.name: makeConfigOverridePath
methods.description: Creates a unique temporary file path for the config override JSON file.

methods.name: `config path respects env override`
methods.description: Verifies that the configuration file path respects an environment variable override.

methods.name: `remote gateway port parses and matches host`
methods.description: Tests parsing and matching of remote gateway URL and port based on environment configuration.

methods.name: `set remote gateway url preserves scheme`
methods.description: Ensures that updating the remote gateway URL maintains the URL scheme.

methods.name: `clear remote gateway url removes only url field`
methods.description: Checks that clearing the remote gateway URL only removes the URL field, preserving other data.

methods.name: `state dir override sets config path`
methods.description: Tests that setting the state directory environment variable updates the config file path accordingly.

methods.name: `save dict appends config audit log`
methods.description: Verifies that saving configuration data appends an audit log entry with correct metadata.

methods.name: `load dict audits suspicious out-of-band clobbers`
methods.description: Checks that loading a modified config file logs suspicious out-of-band modifications and records relevant audit details.
